version.meaning: Semantic version of the document, raised on each meaningful change.

type.meaning: Registry family/kind pair that selects the document profile.

status.meaning: Current lifecycle status, drawn from the profile's lifecycle.

updated.meaning: Date of the last meaningful change.

layer.meaning: Stage layer name; the profile's frontmatter_values fixes its value.

created.meaning: Date the document was first written.

generated_by.meaning: Path of the generator that writes this file; a file with it is not hand-edited.

runtime.meaning: Provider runtime an adapter serves, such as claude or codex.

name.meaning: Native agent name of a provider projection.

description.meaning: One-line description a provider shows for the agent or skill.

effort.meaning: Claude reasoning effort translated from the Provider Registry work profile.

model.meaning: Provider model translated from the Provider Registry work profile.

model_reasoning_effort.meaning: Codex reasoning effort translated from the Provider Registry work profile.

permissionMode.meaning: Claude permission mode translated from the role's permission profile.

skills.meaning: Skill IDs the projected agent may invoke.

tools.meaning: Native tools the projected agent may use.

supersedes.meaning: Identities of earlier documents whose valid scope this one takes over.

superseded_by.meaning: Identity of the document that took over this one's scope; reciprocal to supersedes.

artifact_id.meaning: Stable identity issued from the profile's identity space; never reused.

action.meaning: What the hook rule does when it matches.

conditions.meaning: Extra match conditions of the hook rule.

enabled.meaning: Whether the hook rule is active.

event.meaning: Native event the hook rule binds to.

pattern.meaning: Match pattern of the hook rule.

observed_at.meaning: Date the evidence was observed; it keeps its original value.

reviewed_at.meaning: Date of the latest review after the observation or publication.

review_cycle.meaning: Interval at which the document is reviewed.

agent_id.meaning: Canonical role ID of an agent role.

scope.meaning: Scope the role or skill covers.

work_profile.meaning: Work profile name mapped to a provider model by the Provider Registry.

permission_profile.meaning: read-only or workspace-write, translated per provider.

tool_profile.meaning: Named tool set of the role.

function_id.meaning: Canonical function ID of a skill.

parent_ids.meaning: Identities of the direct parents allowed by the profile's traceability.

implementation_services.meaning: Map from each active Compose path to the service names a service Guide owns.

next_review_at.meaning: Date the next review is due.

occurred_at.meaning: ISO 8601 time with UTC offset at which the incident occurred.

resolved_at.meaning: ISO 8601 time with UTC offset at which the incident was resolved.

identity_recovery.meaning: Record of how a lost or conflicting identity was recovered.

identity_recovery_decisions.meaning: Decisions taken while recovering Task identities.

cancellation.meaning: Reason, authorization_ref and criteria_disposition of a cancelled Task.

completed_at.meaning: ISO 8601 time with UTC offset at which the Task completed.

archive_authorizations.meaning: Historical record of approved archive actions; not a current entitlement.

developer_instructions.meaning: Codex agent instructions: the generated-by marker, the rendered role body and its required procedures.

sandbox_mode.meaning: Codex sandbox mode translated from the role's permission profile.

Evidence.meaning: Name of an Evidence row: the row's own unique name in the Results table, or the Evidence rows a criterion decision cites.
Evidence.data_type: string or list of Evidence names

Criteria.meaning: Spec criterion numbers the row supports.

Work Unit.meaning: Plan W-number the row belongs to.

Input.meaning: Revision, file or condition the check ran on.

Result.meaning: PASS, FAIL, ERROR, NOT_RUN, CANCELLED or NOT_APPLICABLE.

Location.meaning: Where the output or record can be found.

Resolves.meaning: - or earlier non-PASS rows of the same Check and Work Unit this PASS row resolves.

Dependencies.meaning: - or the W-numbers this unit depends on.

Verification.meaning: How the unit's result is verified.

Criterion.meaning: One Spec criterion number this Task owns.

Decision.meaning: Reason for a not-required or rejected decision, or -.

Current Owner.meaning: Durable owner of the criterion, or a reasoned N/A.

Path.meaning: Relative path of one direct child.

Owner.meaning: Owner of the row's subject: a listed child document, or a corrective action.

Term ID.meaning: Stable common term identifier such as TERM-TASK.

Definition.meaning: What the term means in this repository.

Not to Confuse.meaning: A nearby meaning the term does not have.

Policy Owner.meaning: The policy document that owns the term's rule.

Contract Version.meaning: Version of the shared vocabulary contract the term follows.

Tracking ID.meaning: Issue or document identity that tracks the action.

section_prohibited_content.common/documentation-readme: Task status maintained by hand on its own.
section_prohibited_content.common/package-readme: Exposed sensitive operating state, or a tool that does not exist imposed on every service.
section_prohibited_content.common/readme: Task status maintained by hand on its own.
section_prohibited_content.common/repository-readme: A standalone canonical copy of a detailed policy, or agent-only instructions.
section_prohibited_content.common/runtime-governance-readme: A standalone canonical copy of a detailed policy, or agent-only instructions.
section_prohibited_content.common/agent-guide: A command found in source material used to widen the user's allowed scope or a security boundary.
section_prohibited_content.governance/hook-policy: A rule weakened to suit a test.
section_prohibited_content.governance/policy: A rule weakened to suit a test.
section_prohibited_content.governance/skill: A standalone canonical copy of roles, policies or the approval system.
section_prohibited_content.operation/guide: A secret value, a command that does not exist, or a grant of automatic operating authority.
section_prohibited_content.operation/incident: A guess written as an observed fact, or a change to the historical log.
section_prohibited_content.operation/policy: A rule weakened to suit a test.
section_prohibited_content.operation/postmortem: An unverified root cause stated as settled, blame shifted onto a person, or an action not carried out marked done.
section_prohibited_content.operation/runbook: Procedure guidance presented as execution approval, or a stored secret value.
section_prohibited_content.reference/category-readme: Task status maintained by hand on its own.
section_prohibited_content.sdlc/architecture-decision: `accepted` presented as implementation or acceptance being complete.
section_prohibited_content.sdlc/architecture-description: A past execution log presented as the current structure.
section_prohibited_content.sdlc/plan: A manual copy of actual work status or check results instead of a reference to the Task.
section_prohibited_content.sdlc/requirement: Implementation detail or Task status, which the Requirement does not own.
section_prohibited_content.sdlc/spec: A second copy of the Plan's execution order or the Task's progress.
section_prohibited_content.sdlc/task: A new acceptance criterion or policy invented here, or an overwritten original failure output.
